review_candidates.title: IT Operations Associate
review_candidates.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How You'll Help Us Achieve It Our IT Operations team manages our IT infrastructure across all countries with Wave operations. This team ensures that employees have the necessary hardware, software, and internet access to perform their roles efficiently. In addition, the IT Operations team manages various components of the IT infrastructure, including telephony operations, networks and internet, servers, and data centers, across multiple processes such as onboarding, offboarding, employee training, compliance, information security operations, and ticket management. This is a role for an experienced technician ready to work with greater independence, take on the more complex day-to-day requests, coordinate vendors and contribute to small projects, and act as a reliable escalation point for L1. Success in this role is built on strong customer service, operational discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently. In this role, you'll; Provide face-to-face and ticket-based end-user support Act as a senior in-person point of contact for IT in your office, helping colleagues and handling the more complex requests. Independently resolve most user, hardware, workplace technology, and operational support issues. Manage ticket queues, maintain SLA compliance, and act as an escalation point for L1 technicians. Identify recurring issues and recommend service improvements, escalating complex issues with clear context. Deploy and maintain employee and office hardware Provision, deploy, recover, and troubleshoot employee and office hardware, and keep the asset register accurate. Follow and help maintain hardware deployment, inventory, and asset management processes, ensuring your work complies with established standards. Prepare and hand over hardware that meets Wave's configuration and security standards, and coordinate vendors for routine repairs and procurement. Support and troubleshoot the local network and connectivity Independently troubleshoot network, infrastructure, connectivity, and office technology issues. Support hardware installations, cabling, and data centre activities, and coordinate with vendors. Escalate network configuration, design, or recurring infrastructure issues to the Network Engineering and Endpoint Engineering teams with clear context. Support telephony and SMS operations Independently troubleshoot and resolve most SMS outages and SIP/VoIP call failures, interpreting error logs and escalating to Telco partners and Engineering when needed. Act as an escalation point for L1 technicians on telephony issues. Support Telco partner coordination and monthly billing reconciliation, escalating SLA and partner-relationship management to the level that owns telephony. Monitor and help maintain the availability of toll-free numbers and SMPP connections, so support teams can take calls and customers receive SMS notifications reliably. Contribute to projects and operational improvements Help improve operational processes, documentation, and service quality, and follow established standards. Support onboarding and offboarding logistics and keep documentation up to date. Lead small, well-defined projects and coordinate vendors for routine work. Act as an escalation point for L1 technicians and support newer team members by sharing knowledge. Key details Location: You'll be based in our office in Ouagadougou. Work authorization in Burkina is required. This is a permanent position. We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents. We support working parents - we offer (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work. We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes. Airtime reimbursement. Free food and a beautiful office space. Requirements 2+ years supporting employee and office hardware and workplace technology, or equivalent demonstrated ability. Experience administering Google Workspace and using MDM platforms to enrol and deploy hardware (configuration and policy are owned by engineering). Able to independently troubleshoot networking, AV, and office technology issues. Experience supporting hardware installation, cabling, data centre activities, and vendor coordination. Experience with hardware lifecycle, inventory, and asset management processes. Hands-on experience with telephony or SMS/SIP systems (for example toll-free numbers, SMPP, or VoIP), including Telco partner coordination. Familiarity with scripting and process automation (a plus). Comfort acting as an escalation point for more junior technicians. Strong customer service instincts and operational discipline: you follow processes carefully, document accurately, and know when to escalate. Strong communication skills, in person and in writing, in English (B1 or above). Good organizational and problem-solving skills. You might be a good fit if you Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do. Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets. Enjoy organising large events - you'll be the point of contact to both suppliers and the team. Love owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems. Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth. Willing to go the distance to get something done. Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination. Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Provision, maintain, and scale cloud resources in Microsoft Azure in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Monitor cloud resource utilization to ensure cost efficiency and scalability. Troubleshoot and resolve system, application, and infrastructure issues, performing root cause analysis as needed. Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, and operational standards within a DevSecOps framework. Support CI/CD pipelines and integrate infrastructure automation into the development lifecycle. Implement and manage containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, for microservices architectures. Configure and maintain monitoring tools to ensure system and application availability and performance. Identify and implement optimizations to improve efficiency, reduce latency, and enhance system uptime. Apply security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), network segmentation, and encryption, to protect hybrid cloud infrastructures. Assist in audits and compliance initiatives (e.g., RMF, NIST, ISO 27001). Provide Tier-2/3 support for escalated issues, working closely with internal teams and external vendors. Document procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting steps to enhance knowledge sharing. Basic Qualifications US Citizen with at least an active Top Secret security clearance and the ability to obtain a SCI prior to your start date. Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of experience or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of experience. Additional years of experience will be accepted in lieu of a degree. Must have a DoD 8140 Intermediate certification (Security+ CE or equivalent) (formerly DoD-8570 IAT Level 2 baseline certification). Intermediate Azure Certifications such as AZ-104: Azure Administrator Associate or similar certifications from other Cloud Service Providers. Proficiency in virtualization technologies, including VMware, Hyper-V, and OpenStack. Proficiency in public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation. Solid understanding of containerization (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes). Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) and incident management. Solid Understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, and firewalls. Practical knowledge of DevSecOps principles, methodologies, and best practices. Interest in continuous learning and professional development in cybersecurity and DevOps practices. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Air Force programs. Experience with security tools and practices related to DevSecOps (e.g., SAST, DAST, IAST). Experience with compliance standards (e.g., OWASP, NIST) and DoD regulations. Expert cloud certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or similar certification from another cloud provider. Experience with Azure Stack Edge family of devices. Experience with DoD networks, especially classified and operational networks. Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, especially Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), tunneling, QoS, and cloud connectivity solutions (e.g. Azure Express Route). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and security automation. DABAOPP1 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. review_candidates.title: Security Analyst
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Cyber Security Defense Center (CDC) is looking for a new profile to join the Operations Team. As a Tier 1 Cyber Defense Center (SOC) Analyst, you will be tasked with the initial detection, triage, and response to security incidents, reporting, and contributing to continuous improvement. You will collaborate with the CDC Engineering Team, internal Nokia teams, external Security Suppliers, and various technology vendors. This role is for a skilled security professional who will play a critical role in safeguarding Nokia's digital assets through vigilant monitoring and rapid initial response. We are seeking a candidate with a foundational understanding of security principles, and practical experience with security monitoring tools. This individual will be responsible for performing initial security investigations, escalating incidents, and utilizing security tools to maintain a strong security posture. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn Security Monitoring and Triage: Monitor security alerts and events from various security tools and platforms (e.g., SIEM, EDR, Cloud Security tools). Initial Incident Response: Perform initial investigation and triage of security incidents, identifying potential threats and determining their scope and impact. Incident Escalation: Accurately document and escalate security incidents to Tier 2/3 analysts or other relevant teams following established procedures. Tool Utilization: Operate and utilize security tools such as Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI), and SASE solutions for monitoring and initial response. Log Analysis: Conduct basic log analysis to identify suspicious activities and gather evidence related to security events. Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed records of security incidents, investigations, and actions taken. Process Improvement: Assist in improving SOC processes and playbooks by providing feedback on incident handling and tool effectiveness. Threat Awareness: Stay informed about current security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques. Key Skills And Experience Experience: 1-3 years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or similar security monitoring role. Security Fundamentals: Foundational understanding of security principles, common attack vectors, and incident response methodologies. Tooling Experience: Practical experience working with security monitoring tools, specifically with one or more of the following systems: Microsoft Sentinel Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) Wazuh (EDR) SASE solutions Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze security alerts, identify patterns, and perform initial problem-solving. Communication Skills: Ability to communicate technical information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing. Basic Cloud Security: Basic understanding of cloud security principles and common cloud security threats. OS Internals: Basic knowledge of OS internals (Windows/Linux/macOS) and network fundamentals. Recommended Certifications (considered a plus): CompTIA Security+ Microsoft SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst Associate) Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) – EC-Council

review_candidates.title: CSOC Lead
review_candidates.description: EMEA CSOC Lead Location: Cheltenham (hybrid, 3 days onsite) Clearance Type: Must hold or be able to obtain and maintain the highest levels of UK Security Clearance Salary: £52,000 - £77,000 What's your possible? At Northrop Grumman UK, you are part of a team driving innovation where it matters most, solving tomorrow's challenges and shaping the technology solutions of the future. We call it Defining Possible. This mindset goes beyond our customer solutions. It is the foundation for your career development and the impact we have within the community. This is more than just a job. It's a mission. We are looking for an experienced cyber defender and people leader to lead our EMEA Cyber Security Operations Centre (CSOC) team from Cheltenham. This is a rare opportunity to combine technical cyber expertise with leadership responsibility. You'll lead a team of highly capable cyber threat analysts protecting Northrop Grumman UK and EMEA operations, while remaining directly involved in threat hunting, incident response, digital forensics and cyber defence activities. Working as part of a global cybersecurity organisation, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the UK, Europe and the United States, helping shape cyber defence strategy and continuously advancing our ability to identify, investigate and respond to emerging threats. If you're motivated by protecting critical business operations, influencing cyber strategy and leading talented security professionals, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day. What You'll Do As CSOC Lead, you will: Lead, mentor and develop a team of cyber threat analysts, providing direction, coaching and day-to-day operational oversight. Manage security operations across the EMEA region, ensuring effective execution of cyber monitoring, triage, investigation and response activities. Serve as Incident Response Lead for major cyber security events, coordinating technical investigations, containment and remediation activities. Lead advanced threat hunting and digital forensic investigations using SIEM, EDR, network telemetry and threat intelligence sources. Work closely with global CSOC teams to improve cyber defence capabilities, operational processes and detection methodologies. Provide clear and actionable cyber risk updates, technical briefings and executive summaries to senior stakeholders and leadership teams. Represent Northrop Grumman UK within government, industry and security forums, supporting collaboration and information sharing. Drive cyber resilience through exercises, lessons learned activities and continuous improvement initiatives. What We're Looking For Essential Experience Experience leading or managing a Security Operations Centre (SOC) or Cyber Security Operations Centre (CSOC). Proven success leading teams, projects or operational cyber security functions. Strong incident response, cyber threat hunting and digital forensics expertise. Experience using commercial SIEM, EDR and network analysis platforms. Strong understanding of network protocols and traffic analysis across the OSI model. Experience working with cyber threat intelligence methodologies and frameworks. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to executive and non-technical audiences. Strong stakeholder management, decision-making and problem-solving skills. Proficiency across Windows, Linux and Unix environments, including PowerShell and Bash scripting. Desirable Experience Existing trusted relationship with the UK National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC). Experience operating within highly regulated, defence or high-classification environments. Familiarity with NCSC CAF, DEFSTAN, DCC and similar national security frameworks. Experience assessing and responding to sophisticated nation-state and cyber espionage activity. Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, CEH or equivalent. Bachelor's degree or higher in Cyber Security, Computer Science or a related discipline. Most importantly, we're looking for a leader who is passionate about cyber defence, motivated by continuous improvement and committed to developing both people and capability in an ever-evolving threat landscape. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Your experience, potential and perspective could make you an excellent addition to our team. Security Clearance Due to the nature of our work, you must be a UK national and able to gain and maintain UK Government security clearance in line with the job role and requirements. Our recruitment team is on hand to answer any questions and will guide you through the process: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com Benefits We offer a flexible and rewarding benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, career and lifestyle, including: Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements and compressed fortnights with every other Friday off Private healthcare, dental cover, life assurance and pension Flexible benefits package including critical illness cover and health cash plan Holiday buy and sell scheme Career development and learning programmes Annual performance incentive programme Why Join Northrop Grumman UK? A Mission to Believe In Every day we contribute to building a more secure and connected world. You'll work alongside some of the best cyber security professionals in the industry, defending critical technologies and supporting missions that matter. You'll also have opportunities to engage with employee networks, STEM programmes and community initiatives that make a positive impact beyond the workplace. A Place to Belong and Thrive We know that innovation comes from diverse experiences, perspectives and backgrounds. Every voice matters, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. Your Career, Your Way Whether your ambition is to deepen your technical expertise, develop as a leader or influence cyber security strategy on a global scale, we'll provide the support, mentoring and development opportunities to help you achieve your goals. Ready to Apply? Yes – Submit your application online. Possibly – Reach out to our team for more information: talentenquiries@uk.ngc.com No – Explore other opportunities with us. We're growing across the UK and are always looking for talented individuals ready to help define what's possible.

AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together. POSITION SUMMARY: Join a dynamic IT team that powers innovation across a global enterprise. As a Sr IT Site Support Specialist, you'll be at the forefront of delivering exceptional technical support while helping maintain and optimize our Microsoft Windows environment. In this highly visible role, you'll make a direct impact on the productivity of engineers, manufacturing teams, and business operations worldwide by solving complex technical challenges and ensuring seamless technology experiences. This is more than a traditional support role—it's an opportunity to gain exposure to enterprise-scale infrastructure, cybersecurity initiatives, digital transformation efforts, and next-generation technologies. You'll collaborate with a talented team of IT professionals, contribute to automation and continuous improvement projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of our digital workplace. If you're passionate about technology, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy learning and growing your skills, you'll find exciting opportunities to make a difference and advance your career here. Manage system security, passwords, and data integrity to safeguard critical operations. Provide exceptional customer service, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution of issues. Configure wireless devices for secure connectivity to corporate O365 email. Execute software installations, updates, and configurations based on ticketing workflows. Independently image, configure, and deploy new PCs across the organization. Maintain accurate records of PC inventory, assets, and support queues. Support phone systems and assist with user training on applications and tools. Collaborate with Service Desk leadership and outsourcing partners to troubleshoot complex issues. Test and recommend new software and operating systems for deployment. Participate in IT projects aimed at improving end-user experience and operational efficiency. Provide after-hours support as needed. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Location: Denver, Colorado Setting: On-site role at Advanced Energy Headquarters Physical Requirements: Ability to lift up to 40 lbs. Flexibility: Occasional overtime, on-call weekends, and project-based evening work Travel: Up to 10% domestic travel QUALIFICATIONS : Strong customer service orientation and communication skills. Advanced knowledge of Windows 10/11 and TCP/IP networking. Proficiency in Active Directory, Office 365, antivirus/security tools, and PC troubleshooting. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage projects effectively. Problem-solving mindset with sound judgment and decision-making skills. EXPERIENCE: 5+ years in IT support roles with hands-on technical expertise. Proven experience supporting Microsoft PC environments and remote users via VPN. EDUCATION: Required: Associate’s degree in Computer Information Systems Preferred: A+ certification, MCP, and Windows 10/11 certification COMPENSATION: As required by multiple state pay transparency laws, Advanced Energy provides a reasonable range of compensation for each job posting. Actual compensation is influenced by an array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, level of experience, and specific office location. The range of starting pay for this role is $32 to $40 per hour. BENEFITS: As part of our total rewards philosophy, we believe in offering and maintaining competitive compensation and benefits programs for our employees to attract and retain a talented, highly engaged workforce. Our compensation programs are focused on equitable, fair pay practices including market-based base pay, an annual pay-for-performance incentive plan, and discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan. In addition to our competitive compensation practices, we offer a strong benefits package in each of the countries in which we operate. In the U.S., we offer a rich benefits package that includes: Medical - multiple medical plans are available to choose from Short and long-term disability and life insurance Health savings and flexible spending accounts Generous time off policy starting with 3 weeks of paid vacation, 7 days of paid sick time, and 12 paid holidays 8 hours of paid volunteer time off 8 weeks of paid parental leave for both parents Company matched 401(k) Tuition reimbursement Expanded mental health coverage and employee assistance programs Other voluntary benefits include critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity, pet insurance, identity theft, and legal assistance Advanced Energy is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities. If you require assistance in completing an Advanced Energy application, please reach out to HumanResources@aei.com.
